interaction_analysis.definition: For each combined condition, metric deltas relative to the baseline are compared with the sum of the matching motor-only and coordination-only deltas.

e2_interaction_summary.interpretation_boundary: Simulation response surfaces only; no disease severity or biological calibration is assigned.

concordance_assessments.biological_observation: adult neural dopamine deficiency reduces walking speed
concordance_assessments.computational_proxy: frozen E3 motor_scale 0.8 plus coupling_scale 0.75 candidate
concordance_assessments.rationale: The frozen E3 candidate has lower mean planar speed than its paired baseline across all five seeds.

concordance_assessments.biological_observation: adult neural dopamine deficiency reduces covered distance
concordance_assessments.computational_proxy: frozen E3 motor_scale 0.8 plus coupling_scale 0.75 candidate
concordance_assessments.rationale: The frozen E3 candidate has lower path length and lower planar displacement than its paired baseline across all five seeds.

concordance_assessments.biological_observation: old adult A30P flies show reduced walking velocity
concordance_assessments.computational_proxy: frozen E3 motor_scale 0.8 plus coupling_scale 0.75 candidate
concordance_assessments.rationale: The frozen E3 candidate shows a lower mean planar speed than baseline.

concordance_assessments.biological_observation: old adult A30P flies show reduced total moving distance
concordance_assessments.computational_proxy: frozen E3 motor_scale 0.8 plus coupling_scale 0.75 candidate
concordance_assessments.rationale: E3 path length and displacement are both lower in the candidate than in the paired baseline.

concordance_assessments.biological_observation: old adult A30P flies show reduced distance per movement
concordance_assessments.rationale: E3 does not segment movement bouts, so distance per movement is currently unavailable.

concordance_assessments.biological_observation: old adult A30P flies show reduced angular velocity
concordance_assessments.rationale: E3 yaw change is not angular velocity. The observed yaw response is variable and must not be treated as direct concordance.

concordance_assessments.biological_observation: old adult A30P flies show increased centrophobism
concordance_assessments.rationale: The current flat-ground FlyGym report does not model an open-field arena center-avoidance endpoint.

concordance_assessments.biological_observation: no selected adult dopamine or alpha-synuclein walking target
concordance_assessments.rationale: E3 body height changes substantially, but this endpoint is not supported for Parkinson interpretation by the selected literature set.

endpoint_mappings.rationale: Both endpoints describe walking speed, but the assay geometry, duration, animal preparation, and simulation controller differ.
The closest current simulation proxy for velocity is mean planar speed.
Covered distance is closer to path length than net displacement, but the E3 report records both and uses them only directionally.
Total moving distance and simulation path length are directionally comparable, but not directly numerically calibrated.
The current E3 report does not segment movement bouts, so distance per movement is not available.
E3 records net and absolute yaw change, not angular velocity. This endpoint must not be forced into concordance.
Current FlyGym evidence is flat-ground walking, not negative geotaxis.
Pause and freezing metrics are not currently computed.
The current simulation does not include open-field arena center avoidance.
Body height is an observed simulation phenotype and possible confound, but the selected literature set does not define a matching biological Parkinson-model target.

e4_concordance_summary.interpretation_boundary: Qualitative directional concordance only; unsupported endpoints remain unsupported.

overall_status.label: PARTIAL_PHENOTYPE_CONCORDANCE
overall_status.reason: Major adult walking speed and distance directions agree qualitatively with the selected literature, while unsupported endpoints remain explicitly limited.
overall_status.scope: Directional qualitative phenotype concordance only; not Parkinson's disease validation.

e5_reversibility_summary.interpretation_boundary: Computational reversibility only; not biological rescue or treatment response.

frozen_candidate_definition.selection_basis: Frozen E2/E3 computational candidate; no E6 tuning.

scientific_scope: Milestone E6 validates internal consistency and reproducible synthesis of frozen computational evidence. It does not validate a Parkinson's disease model, establish biological realism, or make claims about real flies.

literature_grounded_qualitative_findings: E4 reports directional qualitative concordance for selected adult walking speed and distance endpoints.
not_established: statistical significance from the frozen reports
scientific_synthesis.scope: Milestone E6 validates internal consistency and reproducible synthesis of frozen computational evidence. It does not validate a Parkinson's disease model, establish biological realism, or make claims about real flies.
supported_computational_findings: Reduced motor-command scaling lowers simulated locomotor output.
Reduced CPG coupling affects simulated locomotor output and directionality.
The frozen combined candidate shows multi-seed simulated locomotor-output reduction.
E5 demonstrates computational reversibility, particularly along the motor axis.
